generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Department Registration Details
Total value of civl engineering works executed and payments received in the last five years (year-wise)
List of existing commitments and ongoing work
List of works for which tenders already submitted
Banker Details
The tenderer shall have registered in KPWD under Class-4 and above category. (Scanned copy registration certificate shall be enclosed).

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.

The bidder is required to ensure browser compatibility of the computer well in advance to the last date and time for receipt of tenders. The departments shall not be responsible for non accessibility of e Procurement portal due to internet connectivity issues and technical glitches at bidders end.

As per Karnataka State Government order No LD/300/LET/2006 Bangalore Dated 01.01.2007 and Government Letter No.PW/134/BMS/2007 Dated 27.07.2007, a sum amounting to 1%of the bill amount will be deducted towards Construction Labour Welfare fund.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
The Item Rate quoted shall include the Royalty Charges on construction materials and other taxes as per prevailing Government Orders, except GST, which will be paid separately.
Conditional tenders will not be accepted.
The Tenderer shall obtain the required work done certificates from the Competent Authority not below the rank of Executive Engineer or equivalent.
Financial Year will be reckoned as the period between first day of April and Thirty first day of March of succeeding year (both days inclusive).
The Employer reserves the right to reject any or all Tenders without assigning any reason or whatsoever.
The tenderer shall maintain the Road/Building during the defect liability period at his own cost.
The Department is not responsible for any delay in accessing Karnataka public procurement portal.

Financial turnover of previous years shall be given a weightage of 10% per year to bring them to the price level of the 2026-27. And Value at 2026-27 price level, of existing commitments and on-going works to be executed during the next 12 months (Financial commitment of previous years shall be given a weightage of 10% per year to bring them to the price level of the 2026-27) in the Technical Qualification Criteria mentioned in the next section.

Tenderer shall note that the Tenders of those found Eligible as mentioned in Clause 3 - Qualification of the Tenderer in Section 2: Instructions to Tenderers (ITT), will only be considered for evaluation.
Contractor should follow strictly the prevailing rules of Labour Act and applicable any other law as concerned to work.

It is mandatory for the contractor to upload the work done certificate issued by an officer not below the rank of Executive Engineer duly indicating the work indent numbers for works costing more than Rs.5.00 lakhs.
The tenderer shall note that, the GST at 18% shall be paid to the tendered amount separately.

The tenderer shall note that, the increase in GST shall not be paid in the extended period of contract for which the contractor alone is responsible for delay as determined by the authority while granting the extension of time.

The tenderers shall note that, as per The Karnataka Minor Mineral Concession Rules-1964, it is mandatory to submit the Mineral dispatch Permits (MDPs) issued by a competent authority, along with the bills. If not, penalty will be levied as per the prevailing clauses.

It is mandatory to furnish the information regarding works which are yet to be completed, as on date of submission of his tender, in format-5. The tenderer shall note that, deliberately not furnishing the correct information is liable for rejection of such tenders.

The tenderer shall furnish required information in all formats. Scan and upload all Formats/Original documents required for this bid to the kppp-procurement portal. The Original Formats/Documents shall be produced at the time of opening of Technical Bid for physical verification.

IMPORTANT NOTE : AS THE GOVERNMENT HAS ALLOTTED FIXED AMOUNT OF GRANT UNDER THIS HEAD OF ACCOUNT, NO EXTRA TENDER PREMIUM WILL BE ALLOWED FOR THIS WORK. IF QUOTED EXCESS, SUCH TENDERS ARE LIABLE FOR REJECTION. TENDERERS PLEASE NOTE.
The time stipulated for completion of work is 6 (Six) calendar months including rainy season.
The defect liability period for the work is 12 (twelve) calendar months.

The tenderers shall note that as per the Government Order No.FD/850/EXP-12/15 dated 29-12-2015 and GO No.FD/130/EXP-12/15 dated 8-9-2015, the exemption from payment of EMD for Micro and small enterprises registered with NSIC under single point vendor registration scheme is applicable only for supply of goods but not for works.
Information of the works for which Tender acceptance letters are received.
Information of the works for which Tenderer has submitted Tender.

To qualify for award of this contract, each Tenderer in his name should have in the last five years i.e., 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24 2024-25 and 2025-26 - achieved in at least two financial years a minimum annual average financial turnover (in all classes of Civil Engineering Construction Works only) of Rs.4.22 Lakhs.

To qualify for award of this contract, each Tenderer in his name should have in the last five years i.e., 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24 2024-25 and 2025-26 - Satisfactorily completed as prime contractor, at least one similar work such as - Any Construction works of value not less than Rs.1.06 Lakhs.

itemList.description: Tack coat on Bituminous surface - Providing and applying tack coat with RS1 Bituminous Emulsion using emulsion pressure distributor at the rate of 0.20  kg/m2  on the prepared bituminous surface cleaned with mechanical broom. Ref to MoRT&H : IRC - 503 ---- including cost of all materials, with all lead and lifts, loading and un-loading charges, cost of labour, HOM charges of all machineries, incidental and equipment charges, and implementation of Environmental and Social Safeguards etc., complete and as per the directions of engineer-incharge of work.

Semi Dense Bituminous Concrete - Providing  and  laying  Semi  Dense  Bituminous  Concrete  with 40/60  TPH  capacity   hot  mix  plant  batch  type  using  crushed aggregates of specified grading premixed with bituminous binder VG-30  @  5%  by  weight  of  mix  and  filler,  transported  to  site, laid over a previously prepared surface with mechanical paver finisher to the required grade, level and alignment and rolled as per MoRTH V revision. Ref to MoRT&H : IRC - IRC-37:2018 ---- including cost of all materials, with all lead and lifts, loading and un-loading charges, cost of labour, HOM charges of all machineries, incidental and equipment charges, and implementation of Environmental and Social Safeguards etc., complete and as per the directions of engineer-incharge of work.
